ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (28) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Земельная собственность» (zemel'naya sobstvennost') is 'landed property' or 'property in land', and the italic *theft* (воровство, vorovstvo) keeps Tolstoy's emphasis. Attributions follow the print (Rousseau, Herbert Spencer, Grant Allen, Henry George).
Source observation: [19] the Henry George passage has no final period after «без воды» ('without water'); a period is supplied in the English
